description.text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Arts Intensity <@ba.vup>+{phy_spell_up:0}</>. 
After the wearer applies <#ba.burning>Combustion</>, the wearer gains <@ba.fire>Heat DMG</> +<@ba.vup>{fire_dmg_up:0%}</> for {duration}s. After the wearer applies <#ba.corrupt>Corrosion</>, the wearer gains <@ba.natur>Nature DMG</> +<@ba.vup>{nature_dmg_up:0%}</> for {duration2}s. The aforementioned effects cannot stack.
